name: Streaming Corporate Involution In The Age Of Ai The Governance And Cultural Driver C0D75271E4
text: Corporate Involution in the Age of AI: The Governance and Cultural Drivers of Innovation presents the following source proposition: Using a sample of 25,848 firm-year observations from 3,474 Chinese A-share manufacturing firms over 2012–2024, we examine the effect of AI adoption on corporate involution. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that The combined total addressable market of the industries disrupted by AI, counting healthcare, finance, retail, manufacturing, logistics, transportation, and customer service, is likely in the hundreds of trillions of dollars. The proposed response is an extension: the relationship should remain limited to the retrieved source proposition and the mapped Kaal claim unless fuller source review supports a broader conclusion.
